sql.query: SELECT u.id userId,COALESCE(NULLIF(u.displayName,''),CONCAT_WS(' ',u.fName,u.lName),u.email) userName,u.email FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=ut.userId AND u.isActive=1 WHERE ut.userId=:recipientUserId AND ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' AND ut.userId<>:currentUser AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='TEAM_CHAT' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles membership INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=membership.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='chat.view' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE membership.userId=:currentUser2 AND membership.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND membership.isActive=1) LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id FROM tbl_chat_conversations c INNER JOIN tbl_chat_participants mine ON mine.conversationId=c.id AND mine.tenantId=c.tenantId AND mine.userId=:currentUser AND mine.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_chat_participants theirs ON theirs.conversationId=c.id AND theirs.tenantId=c.tenantId AND theirs.userId=:recipientUser AND theirs.isActive=1 WHERE c.tenantId=:tenantId AND c.conversationType='direct' AND c.directKey=CONCAT(LEAST(:currentUser2,:recipientUser2),'-',GREATEST(:currentUser3,:recipientUser3)) AND c.isActive=1 AND :recipientCount>0 LIMIT 1

SELECT msg.id,msg.messageCiphertext,msg.messageIv,msg.messageAuthTag,msg.messageKeyVersion,msg.conversationId messageConversationId,msg.createdDate,msg.senderUserId,COALESCE(u.displayName,CONCAT_WS(' ',u.fName,u.lName),u.email) senderName,CAST(msg.senderUserId=:currentUser AS UNSIGNED) isMine FROM tbl_chat_messages msg INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=msg.senderUserId WHERE msg.tenantId=:tenantId AND msg.conversationId=:conversationId AND msg.isDeleted=0 AND :conversationCount>0 ORDER BY msg.id ASC LIMIT 200
